name: Golden Legionnaire Dedication
text:
Access You're invited by a current member of the Eagle Knights or the People's Council.

---
You're a wall of metal standing against the tide of Andoran's enemies. When you Raise a Shield, you also gain your shield's circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against attempts to grapple, reposition, or shove you. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Warfare Lore. If you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

---
Special You can take this dedication even if you haven't taken more than two non-dedication feats from the Eagle Knight archetype.

Golden Legionnaire
